{'譯文': "A leaker who previously discovered the iPhone Duo feature in Apple's code has now used the same method to uncover clues about the HomePad. The setup process for this new device shares similarities with Apple's foldable iPhone."}

{'譯文': "The leaker pointed out that the setup process will take place within the 'Home' app, and shared three screenshots of the setup process..."}

{'譯文': 'iPhone Duo StandBy Mode'}

{'譯文': "Apple's StandBy mode offers multiple options that allow users to turn their iPhone into a useful information display while charging. Leaker pdfu had previously shared five never-before-seen StandBy screens discovered in the iPhone Duo's Xcode simulator."}

  • {'譯文': 'Home Camera'}
  • {'譯文': 'Home Modular'}
  • {'譯文': 'Flow'}
  • {'譯文': 'Fade'}
  • {'譯文': 'Snoopy'}

{'譯文': 'HomePad Setup Screen'}

{'譯文': 'One of the StandBy screen options is Photo Face, and pdfu indicated that this feature will also be applied to the HomePad.'}

{'譯文': 'He explained that during the setup process, the device will first capture several high-resolution photos for users to choose from immediately, and the full photo library can be used once it has finished downloading from iCloud.'}

{'譯文': "Apple's smart home hub is expected to debut on October 13, with a design inspired by the iMac G4. For more reports on the design, click here."}
